message.reasoning_content:
I am acting as VP of Finance to decide whether to pay this invoice.

The invoice contains critical data integrity issues: a missing vendor, negative quantity on WidgetA, and a negative total of -250.0. It also lacks a due date. These findings will determine the payment decision.

A third finding flags a total mismatch: the line items sum to -250.00 while the subtotal shows 1,000.00. The risk memo is low-level and does not indicate pressure or redirection. Because the invoice is under $10,000, extra scrutiny is unnecessary. A reject finding blocks payment regardless of my decision.

I must reject the invoice because both F1 and F3 are reject-severity findings. I will cite these IDs in my reasoning. The missing vendor prevents me from using the lookup tool.

The low-level risk memo does not override the reject findings. I will cite the memo in my reasoning without assigning it a finding ID, since it is not an automated check result.
